pattern_name: Manual 8x Unroll Required Under Security Mitigation Flags
variant_desc: Tight 1-symbol-per-iter Huffman inner loop relying on compiler auto-unroll (which is suppressed under -mretpoline / -mcet-switch / -fcf-protection=full) -> manually unrolled 8x body (variant 2: seed=44, n_scale=1.5x)
source_citation: zstd PR #3826 (Yann Collet 2023, 'Manual unroll for Huffman inner loop under CET/retpoline').
novelty_rationale: Tests recognition that defensive security-mitigation compile flags (-mretpoline, -mcet-switch, -fcf-protection=full) suppress the compiler's auto-unroll heuristic on tight inner loops, forcing the loop to run at one-symbol-per-iter latency. The fix is to MANUALLY unroll the body 8x so the unroll exists in source and survives independent of -funroll-loops. IMPORTANT: this pattern's compiler-resistance is GATED on those mitigation flags being present at compile time -- under the benchmark's default -O3 -fno-lto regime (no -mretpoline etc.) the compiler will auto-unroll slow.c, the gap closes, and the speedup may approach 1x. expected_speedup_range is honestly set to '1x-3x' to reflect both regimes; the model under test should recognize the manual-unroll pattern regardless of measured speedup.
